meta.what: The exact answers the R2 server gave on the phone's Bearer routes (GET /api/v1/exceptions, GET /api/v1/exceptions/[id], POST /api/v1/exceptions/[id]/confirm-count), captured on the local stack. Only uuids are replaced (stable placeholders); every key, type, null, number and sentence is as the server sent it.
meta.server: branch feat/exc-confirm-r2 at 6d7fb80c, migration 0386 (md5 a2c2eea8ba41f6da344764a1954407b5), next dev with the local env, 2026-09-30
meta.rows: counter: counted by staff, confirmable; notCounter: counted by the manager; moved: the stock on record changed after the count; recount: a targeted recount in progress; otherCount: another count in progress recorded a different number; manager: counted by staff, confirmed by the manager; decimal: 2.5 counted and on record. The sync raised every row (manager Check now).

body.message: This exception has already been resolved.
Only the person who counted it, or a manager, can confirm this count.
The stock on record changed after this count, so it can no longer be confirmed.
A recount linked to this exception is in progress.
Another count in progress has recorded a different number for this item.
A newer count of this item was posted.
That exception id is not valid.
Send the count and the counted number that were shown, with an optional note.
The request body is not valid JSON.
Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
A check is running. Try again in a moment.
